notes.title: Full Game Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
It has been more than 4.5 years since we created the very first prototype of Bamerang and it's a very special moment for us to finally release this first game of ours.

Get ready to smack your friends with boomerangs, when the full version of Bamerang launches on April 22nd!

If you haven't already, wishlist Bamerang! That would help us out a lot <3

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1236490/Bamerang/

In the full game of Bamerang, you'll get..

 chaotic 2-4 player FFA or team games!
 over 20 map variations
 multi-round games, leading to celebrating winscreen
 more joyfull soundtracks by Lucien Montandon


Drop by in our Discord if you want to chat with us or other players :)

We hope you are just as excited as us about Bamerang's full release!
Lululu Entertainment
